Calculate width of rendered text

get_text_width.Rd

Takes a string of text to render via magick::image_annotate() with the specified options, and calculates the pixel width of the text.

Usage

get_text_width(text, font_size, font_family, font_style, font_weight)

Arguments

text

character. The text to be rendered, i.e. the text argument passed to magick::image_annotate().

font_size

numeric. The size argument passed to magick::image_annotate().

font_family

character. The font argument passed to magick::image_annotate().

font_style

character. The style argument passed to magick::image_annotate().

font_weight

numeric. The weight argument passed to magick::image_annotate().

Value

integer. The pixel width of the specified text.
